text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Forgive me. I let my guard down for 
a moment. There is no problem.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I apologize for causing you concern. I 
will be more careful from now on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps exhausted from the race, Mejiro 
Ardan seems unable to focus on her 
training. It might be necessary to review 
her race schedule."
